questions.question: Which declaration stores a whole number in C#?
questions.explanation: The int type stores whole numbers, such as 25.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an if statement?

options.text: To repeat code a fixed number of times.
To execute code when a condition is true.

questions.explanation: An if statement executes its body when its condition evaluates to true.

questions.question:
How many times does this loop execute its body?

for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
questions.explanation: The body executes for i = 0, 1 and 2. When i becomes 3, the condition is false.
The method adds its two integer parameters and returns their sum: 5.
